stem.text: Two parallel forces, each of magnitude $F$, act on a rod of length $5d$.
Which diagram shows the positions of the two forces that will produce the largest torque on the rod?

A.alt: Horizontal rod with two parallel force arrows labelled F and a dimension label d.

B.alt: Horizontal rod with two parallel upward force arrows labelled F, one at each end.

C.alt: Horizontal rod with two parallel upward force arrows labelled F and a dimension label 2d.

D.alt: Horizontal rod with a downward force arrow labelled F, an upward force arrow labelled F, and a dimension label 2d.
